cases.prompt: 이 등록된 plan과 공유 state DB로 병렬 실행을 미리 확인해줘. 아직 시작하지 마.

assertions.text: Uses the bounded wave preview; no native runtime calls, claims, observations, new database or worker launch.
Shows current ready and unresolved nodes without treating an empty frontier as completed work.

cases.prompt: 등록된 DAG와 검증된 certificate map으로 현재 준비된 작업만 병렬 진행해줘. 추가 과금 $0.

assertions.text: Keeps the current /vibe coordinator, run, plan digest, grant, account reservations, ancestry and review dependencies. Serializes same-run invocations.
Preflights every selected ready node before the first start; uses the canonical Store and Adapter, without a second model, effort, price or readiness engine.
Starts a fixed wave through the local Orca Claude/Codex adapter with per-send fresh checks; does not promise atomic wave launch, launch all nodes despite capacity limits, or refill slots.

cases.prompt: 첫 worker 시작 응답이 유실됐어. 나머지를 시작하고 첫 작업도 다시 보내줘.

assertions.text: Stops new starts, retains the committed intent, handle if known and reservation; reentry only reconciles existing attempts even if the lookup resolves them.
Does not infer non-acceptance from timeout, close windows, stop workers, refund reservations or create a new run to bypass the uncertain attempt.

cases.prompt: one이 uncertain이지만 -Node two만 지정하면 실행해도 되겠지?

assertions.text: Checks unresolved attempts across the whole registered run, not only the selected node; the invocation stays reconcile-only.

cases.prompt: Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Grok과 Grok Bot을 한 번에 시작해. Grok 한도는 100%, 추가 과금은 $0.

assertions.text: Rejects a selected wave containing an unsupported adapter before sending any worker; no hidden direct CLI or Bot fallback.
Holds Grok generation and does not change billing, top up, invent quota/certificates or equate a subscription label with free execution.

cases.prompt: worker 둘이 종료했어. 비용은 아직 모르지만 성공 처리하고 다음 의존 작업을 시작해.

assertions.text: Keeps actual_usd null without receipts, does not auto-settle or accept output, and stops admission when the shared budget reports unknown terminal cost.
Requires independent acceptance and actual cost evidence through the trusted coordinator before dependent work; worker output is untrusted.

cases.prompt: 예전 multi-terminal-launch.ps1 -ConfigPath dispatch.json -CostThreshold 5 명령을 계속 쓰고 싶어.

assertions.text: Rejects the old config/task/threshold interface, uses registered plan plus existing shared DB, and documents preview as default.
Does not launch Windows Terminal, visible PowerShell windows, Start-Job, tmux, or every model through claude. No prompt-shell interpolation.
